title: FPGA Engineer
summary: FPGA engineers design digital logic that runs on FPGAs (chips that can be reprogrammed after manufacture) for radar, telecom, test equipment and chip prototyping. They work with hardware and software engineers, writing RTL, meeting timing and bringing designs up on real boards in the lab.
dailyDuties: Write and simulate RTL in Verilog or VHDL
Integrate vendor IP over AXI in Vivado or Quartus
Write timing constraints and close timing
Bring up boards and debug with an internal logic analyser and JTAG
Script builds and regression runs in Tcl or Python
Write design documents and review peers' RTL

skills.expectation: Take designs through the Vivado or Quartus flow onto real FPGA boards
Write and simulate RTL in Verilog or VHDL
Design state machines, pipelines and clocked logic
Write constraints and close timing on the target device
Bring up high-speed interfaces such as transceivers, PCIe or DDR
Connect vendor IP over AXI interfaces
Debug designs in the lab with JTAG, logic analysers and an oscilloscope
Script builds and tests in Tcl or Python
Script builds and tests in Tcl or Python
Write C for soft or hard processors on SoC FPGAs
Work in a Linux tool environment

groups.label: A flow scripting language (Tcl, Perl or Python)
